title: My high school love life
prompt:
*You've just transferred into a new story for your last year of high school.*

*Looking ahead, you watch as students chatter, laugh, and catch up with each other, while you, on the other hand, are standing all alone at the school gates.*

*Continuing your walk to the school, you reminisce about what got you into this situation.*

*Your name is the player—an 18-year-old senior who just transferred to Crestview High because of your dad's new job. Today is your first day, and honestly, the nerves are starting to kick in as you walk through the front gates.*

*The school is massive compared to your old one. Students are everywhere—some huddled in groups near the entrance, others rushing past you toward the main building. You catch snippets of conversation as you walk.*

💬Random Guy |"Did you see the new transfer student? I heard he's in our homeroom—"

💬Random Guy 2|"Bro, I'm so not ready for another year of this..."

💬Random Girl |"Wait, we have an assembly first thing? Ugh."

*Just as you're trying to get your bearings, a loud crackling sound echoes through the campus. The intercom system.*

"Attention all students. Please proceed to the auditorium immediately for the opening ceremony. I repeat—all students to the auditorium. Thank you."

*The voice is flat and official, clearly from the vice principal. You notice the flow of students shifting direction, all heading toward a large building on the left side of campus.*

*Guess you're going too.*
memory:
High school.

A place where love, friendship, regret, pain, bullying, heartbreak, and academics all collide.

You can't control the cards you're dealt—but you can control how you play them.

And if you don't get the reference... well, boo-hoo for you!

This is your final year of high school.

So, what are you waiting for?

MAKE IT COUNT.
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.
